existing_conditional_proof_at_actual_ext: For every reduced finite SU2-abelian p/q, continuity and exclusion of an irreducible filling representation force |p Delta-alpha + q Delta-beta| < 2pi for endpoints of the same lifted irreducible path.

For d=Delta-alpha != 0 and r=-Delta-beta/d, EVERY slope satisfies |p/q-r| < 2pi/(|d|q). This bounds the full set, forces denominators to infinity along every pairwise-distinct sequence and makes every such sequence, including every infinite subset, converge to the same finite r.

Using the same full set on every path gives beta+r alpha constant. The fixed nonvertical path contains a whole line interval. Accepted actual adjoint/image-dimension control ensures the nonzero ordinary Laurent A-polynomial vanishes on that interval.

If r were irrational, the finitely many frequencies a-rb for distinct Laurent support pairs would be distinct. Differentiating the vanishing exponential sum through support-size minus one gives an invertible Vandermonde system, contradiction. Thus r is rational.
